cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password after Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available choices for multiple saved credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Password Manager picks up updated password
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website is saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Verify disabling password manager stops saving prompts and prefilling
cases.description: Disable the password manager from the preferences panel, then verify that the browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password in password manager through preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password in the password manager is saved, this information can be viewed in the password manager through the preferences panel.

cases.title: Remove username and password for a given site
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a given site are removed, they no longer autofill on that site and are no longer listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Verify that removing all username and password information results in no autofill on sites and nothing listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-aligned with the requirements, distinct, and adequately cover the specified behaviors without noticeable blockers, speculative cases, or missing scenarios.
All test cases map cleanly to the provided requirements and are complete. No blockers or speculative behaviors were identified.

analysis.analysis: R-102: Describes a single straightforward action of discarding the password when Never For This Site is selected; only a single Normal test scenario is warranted. R-103: Multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved and later available to be presented; Normal path covered. R-104: A saved password is later changed, and the password manager picks up the new password; Normal path covered. R-105: Password manager is disabled from preferences, resulting in no prompt to save and no prefilled info; Normal path covered. R-106: Saved username and password can be viewed in the password manager through preferences; only a single Normal test scenario is warranted. R-107: Removal of a username and password for a given site results in no autofill and no listing in the manager; Normal path covered. R-108: Removal of all username and password information results in no autofill and nothing listed in the manager; Normal path covered.
